text:
Mia Chen: Quick draft of release notes for 0.23.4 — small perf fixes + canary. Pls scan for rollback language and pin owner. Patch deploy window 10:00-10:20 PT.
Jordan: LGTM overall, can we be explicit about feature flags? add a line: `flag: enable_fast_path=false by default`?
Samir: +1 on flags. Also add a note about metrics regression alert thresholds.
Mia Chen: Good call. New snippet:
```
Release 0.23.4
- Perf: reduce KV cache miss overhead on long contexts
- Fix: backpressure bug that could stall small-batch requests
- Ops: default feature flag `enable_fast_path=false`; canary on 10% traffic
Rollback: pin to 0.23.3 and disable canary; rollback checklist in Ops runbook
Schedule: Wed 10:00 PT, change window 20m
```
Lucy: wording looks fine. For internal announce: short blurb + link to RN doc. Draft blurb:
"Heads-up: rolling out 0.23.4 Wed 10:00 PT. Small perf fixes; canary 10% then 100% if healthy. No user-facing changes expected. See internal release notes <link>."
Alex R: Ops: I can own pin/rollback. Assign me as pin owner.
ops-bot: Reminder: ops-standby rota set for Wed 09:50-11:30 PT — Alex R assigned.
Jordan: Deploybot — can we get a staging deploy run and a smoke test pass before canary?
deploy-bot: staging deploy triggered by @Mia Chen. Job ID: 9876-smoke. Status: queued.
Mia Chen: triggering smoke now.
deploy-bot: Job 9876-smoke: running
deploy-bot: Job 9876-smoke: passed (logs: https://ci/reports/9876)
Samir: Can someone add the release note link to the internal announce draft? I'll paste into GH issue.
Mia Chen: added link to RN doc in the blurb. final blurb below.
```
Internal: Rolling release 0.23.4 — Wed 10:00 PT (20m window). Small perf and reliability fixes. Canary 10% -> 100% if smoke and metrics ok. Pin owner: Alex R. Rollback plan: pin to 0.23.3 + disable canary; follow Ops runbook (link).
```
Lucy: ready to send post-smoke. :thumbsup: 
Alex R: I'll standby at 09:45 PT. If anything odd, I'll flip pin and notify #eng-oncall.
Mia Chen: thanks. If no objections we'll pin the internal announce at 09:55 and blast at 10:05 during canary start.
Jordan: no objections from me.
Samir: no objections.
deploy-bot: Note: production canary will be gated by the `smoke` job + metric thresholds: error_rate < 0.5% and p99 latency < 1.2x baseline.
Mia Chen: noted. tagging final participants for visibility: @Jordan @Samir @Lucy @Alex R. Will post final in eng-releases at 09:55.
ops-bot: Checkpoint reminder set for 09:55 PT.
